name: Saving_Money_Project
title: FinVue — Personal Finance Tracker
description: A full-stack personal finance tracker built to replace spreadsheet budgeting with a glassmorphic dashboard. Vue 3 (Vite) on the frontend, Python FastAPI on the backend, with MySQL/SQLite storage and JWT-based authentication.
features: Glassmorphic dashboard UI inspired by premium wallet apps
FastAPI backend with bcrypt password hashing and JWT auth
MySQL/SQLite-backed schema for transactions and categories

name: Saving-Calculator-
title: Savings Calculator
description: A desktop GUI savings calculator that visualizes compound monthly savings growth with live animated charts.
features: Tkinter GUI for initial amount, monthly contribution, and duration inputs
Animated Matplotlib chart showing savings growth month by month
Live summary of final amount and total contributed

name: Student_Portal
title: University Student Portal
description: A university student portal that calculates grades, academic standing, and projected graduation timelines, with a glassmorphism UI and a JSON Server backend simulating student record lookups.
features: Object-oriented JavaScript (ES6 classes) for student/score logic
Glassmorphism UI built with CSS variables and responsive layout
JSON Server backend simulating record management

name: chatroom_vuejs
title: Chatroom (Vue.js)
description: A real-time chatroom application built with Vue.js as a hands-on exercise in component-based UI and live messaging UX.
features: Vue CLI single-page app architecture
Component-driven chat UI

name: Trip.com
title: Trip.com Clone
description: A front-end clone of the Trip.com travel booking interface, built with Create React App to practice layout, component composition, and booking-flow UI patterns.
features: React component-based booking UI
Responsive travel-search layout

name: POS_System
title: POS System
description: A point-of-sale system for an online store, covering product listing, cart, and checkout flows with a Vue CLI front end.
features: Vue CLI-based storefront and checkout flow
Cart and order management UI

name: Temperature-Fan
title: Temperature Fan (IoT)
description: An IoT project enabling remote, web-based control of a cooling fan with automatic power on/off logging — a natural extension of hands-on networking and infrastructure experience into embedded/IoT systems.
features: Remote on/off control over the web
Automatic logging of power state changes
Embedded firmware (C++) paired with a PHP-based control dashboard

name: A-Burgar-POS-delivery-system
title: Burger POS & Delivery System
description: A Dockerized full-stack prototype for a food delivery application with integrated point-of-sale functionality — Next.js frontend, FastAPI backend, MySQL database, and Nginx reverse proxy orchestrated with Docker Compose.
features: Nginx reverse proxy routing traffic to the frontend (port 80) and backend API (/api)
Auto-generated API documentation at /docs via FastAPI
Persistent MySQL database with Docker volume support
Single-command Docker Compose orchestration for dev and production
